# float rounding of inline integration sites (tool tolerance loop, each listed in the tool report).
t60conv 024AE0E8 024AE548 024AE080
# the t60cand functions 024AE080 on the t60conv line (before: never N-step compared)
# same-unit callees with converted sites run their candidate code under their callers (tools/t60conv)
real 024AE080
t60cand 024AE080
# c_lib eases run their converted (dt-aware) code (t60conv default, 2026-11-20; a mocked or plain-real ease ignores the step dt)
src wwhd_src/SSystem/SComponent/c_lib.cpp
real 0200F5C8
t60cand 0200F5C8
# mAlpha chased by cLib_chaseF per step (converted: two half steps against one): float rounding only (the low byte)
t60tol 024AE0E8 r3+0x424 f32 absrel 0.00001 0.00001
